content.caption: Green checkmark icon marking enabled wiki access in the WikiSkill ablation table
content.description: A small green checkmark (tick) icon on a plain white background, with no text, arrows or other elements. In the page context it is the symbol used in Table 3 (ablation study of WikiSkill using Gemini-3.5-Flash) to indicate that a component has wiki access enabled during skill evolution; the contrasting red cross indicates wiki access is disabled. Green checks appear in the 'Inference Agent Wiki Access' column for the configuration where only the Inference Agent has access (Avg. 45.3) and for the configuration where both components have access (Avg. 60.9). They appear in the 'Skill Proposer Wiki Access' column for the both-access configuration (Avg. 60.9) and for the default WikiSkill configuration, where only the Skill Proposer has wiki access (Avg. 63.7, the highest average).
